rows.role_title: Президент Российской Федерации — President of the Russian Federation
rows.text: The site reports that Putin's motorcade entered the Kremlin a few minutes before noon, that he ascended the podium in the Andreyevsky Hall exactly at noon, that the CEC chairman reported the official results, that Putin took the presidential oath, and that under the Constitution the elected President obtains the right to exercise his powers after taking the oath.

bounded_scope: Presidency observations for CLAUDE-C01-14 only. Election calling, voting, result determination, declaration, correction and publication, oath, stated assumption of office, inauguration ceremony, resignation, acting service and outgoing-holder statements stay separate rows; holder boundaries are decided in the packet, not by any row.
